name: aws_lex_bot
description: Creates an Amazon Lex bot for building conversational interfaces using voice and text.

child_directed.name: child_directed
child_directed.description: By specifying true, you confirm that your use of Amazon Lex is related to a website, program, or other application that is directed in whole or in part, to children under age 13.

locale.name: locale
locale.description: Specifies the target locale for the bot.

idle_session_ttl_in_seconds.name: idle_session_ttl_in_seconds
idle_session_ttl_in_seconds.description: The maximum time in seconds that Amazon Lex retains the data gathered in a conversation.

detect_sentiment.name: detect_sentiment
detect_sentiment.description: When set to true user utterances are sent to Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis.

enable_model_improvements.name: enable_model_improvements
enable_model_improvements.description: Set to true to enable access to natural language understanding improvements.

nlu_intent_confidence_threshold.name: nlu_intent_confidence_threshold
nlu_intent_confidence_threshold.description: Determines the threshold where Amazon Lex will insert the AMAZON.FallbackIntent.

process_behavior.name: process_behavior
process_behavior.description: If you set the process_behavior element to BUILD, Amazon Lex builds the bot.

voice_id.name: voice_id
voice_id.description: The Amazon Polly voice ID that you want Amazon Lex to use for voice interactions with the user.
